summary.headline: Fixed-Star Inceptions and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological judgments for inceptions based on fixed stars: five stars of Mars and Jupiter signify kings, generals, military appointments, and expeditions; five of Saturn and Jupiter signify acquisitive and beneficial undertakings such as building temples and cities; a Mars–Saturn star signifies reckless, arrogant, rapacious soldiers and poor outcomes.
